mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the broader economic context.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.0% and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a severe demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 7.0% and HOUST < 1400 thousand units, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) signals economic overheating, prompting monetary tightening expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO > 102.0 leads to positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of the broader economic context.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100.0 leads to positive 5-day returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1400 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1400 thousand units, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of labor market tightness (high payroll growth), a strong increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the labor market tightness regime, PAYEMS growth above 0.5% leads to positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
